source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Organisers can use the terrain layouts from Games Workshop events with the current Chapter Approved Mission Deck. The Warhammer Studio designed them to create trade-offs tied to each mission’s objectives. Each Primary Mission has three recommended layouts named A, B and C. The organiser can specify which layout to use, or the players can determine it at random.

selection: players select at random from the three for that Primary Mission
